scope: Current MuJoCo/H1-2 roll-pitch standing revision; separate from legacy Unity release
archival_note: Archived run manifests and absolute checkpoint fields are retained unchanged. This release manifest supplies the hashes of the actual released files; model_index.json maps archived checkpoint paths to portable repository paths. Old aggregate statistics are not used.
